<pre><code class="language-json">{
  "openapi": "3.1.0",
  "info": {
    "title": "Pakperk API",
    "description": "Stable v1 paper-reading API with optional OIDC-backed account profiles, synchronized To Read libraries, and moderated flat paper comments. Comment publication has an independent emergency kill switch which preserves reads and safety controls.",
    "license": {
      "name": "MIT",
      "identifier": "MIT"
    },
    "version": "1.0.0"
  },
  "paths": {
    "/health/live": {
      "get": {
        "tags": [
          "routes::health"
        ],
        "operationId": "health_live",
        "responses": {
          "200": {
            "description": "Process is live",
            "headers": {
              "Cache-Control": {
                "schema": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "Always no-store"
              }
            },
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/HealthResponseSchema"
                },
                "example": {
                  "status": "ok"
                }
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    },
    "/health/ready": {
      "get": {
        "tags": [
          "routes::health"
        ],
        "operationId": "health_ready",
        "responses": {
          "200": {
            "description": "Database is ready",
            "headers": {
              "Cache-Control": {
                "schema": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "Always no-store"
              }
            },
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/HealthResponseSchema"
                },
                "example": {
                  "status": "ready"
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "503": {
            "description": "Dependency unavailable",
            "headers": {
              "Cache-Control": {
                "schema": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "Always no-store"
              }
            },
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelopeSchema"
                }
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    },
    "/v1/annotation-conflicts": {
      "get": {
        "tags": [
          "research-memory"
        ],
        "operationId": "list_annotation_conflicts",
        "parameters": [
          {
            "name": "cursor",
            "in": "path",
            "required": true,
            "schema": {
              "type": [
                "string",
                "null"
              ]
            }
          },
          {
            "name": "limit",
            "in": "path",
            "required": true,
            "schema": {
              "type": [
                "integer",
                "null"
              ],
              "format": "int32",
              "minimum": 0
            }
          }
        ],
        "responses": {
          "200": {
            "description": "Account-wide unresolved annotation conflicts paired with current canonical revisions",
            "headers": {
              "Cache-Control": {
                "schema": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "Always private, no-store"
              },
              "Vary": {
                "schema": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "Always Authorization"
              }
            },
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/AnnotationConflictPageEnvelope"
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "400": {
            "description": "Invalid or stale conflict cursor",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelopeSchema"
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "401": {
            "description": "Authentication required",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelopeSchema"
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "403": {
            "description": "Account unavailable",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelopeSchema"
                }
              }
            }
          }
        },
        "security": [
          {
            "oidcBearer": []
          }
        ]
      }
    },
    "/v1/annotations": {
      "get": {
        "tags": [
          "research-memory"
        ],
        "operationId": "list_annotations",
        "parameters": [
          {
            "name": "paper_id",
            "in": "path",
            "required": true,
            "schema": {
              "type": [
                "string",
                "null"
              ],
              "format": "uuid"
            }
          },
          {
            "name": "after_revision",
            "in": "path",
            "required": true,
            "schema": {
              "type": [
                "integer",
                "null"
              ],
              "format": "int64"
            }
          },
          {
            "name": "limit",
            "in": "path",
            "required": true,
            "schema": {
              "type": [
                "integer",
                "null"
              ],
              "format": "int32",
              "minimum": 0
            }
          }
        ],
        "responses": {
          "200": {
            "description": "Principal-scoped annotation changes and tombstones",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/AnnotationPageEnvelope"
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "400": {
            "description": "Invalid revision or scope",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelopeSchema"
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "401": {
            "description": "Authentication required",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelopeSchema"
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "403": {
            "description": "Account unavailable",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelopeSchema"
                }
              }
            }
          }
        },
        "security": [
          {
            "oidcBearer": []
          }
        ]
      }
    },
    "/v1/annotations/export": {
      "get": {
        "tags": [
          "research-memory"
        ],
        "operationId": "export_annotations",
        "parameters": [
          {
            "name": "format",
            "in": "path",
            "required": true,
            "schema": {
              "oneOf": [
                {
                  "type": "null"
                },
                {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ResearchExportFormat"
                }
              ]
            }
          },
          {
            "name": "paper_id",
            "in": "path",
            "required": true,
            "schema": {
              "type": [
                "string",
                "null"
              ],
              "format": "uuid"
            }
          },
          {
            "name": "paged",
            "in": "path",
            "description": "Opts into the lossless cursor contract. Supplying a cursor also opts in.",
            "required": true,
            "schema": {
              "type": [
                "boolean",
                "null"
              ]
            }
          },
          {
            "name": "cursor",
            "in": "path",
            "required": true,
            "schema": {
              "type": [
                "string",
                "null"
              ]
            }
          }
        ],
        "responses": {
          "200": {
            "description": "Principal-scoped JSON or Markdown research export",
            "headers": {
              "X-Pakperk-Export-Complete": {
                "schema": {
                  "type": "boolean"
                },
                "description": "True when this is the final export part"
              },
              "X-Pakperk-Export-Next-Cursor": {
                "schema": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "Opaque principal- and scope-bound cursor for the next bounded part"
              },
              "X-Pakperk-Export-Page": {
                "schema": {
                  "type": "integer",
                  "format": "int32",
                  "minimum": 0
                },
                "description": "One-based part number within this export snapshot"
              }
            }
          }
        },
        "security": [
          {
            "oidcBearer": []
          }
        ]
      }
    },
    "/v1/annotations/import": {
      "post": {
        "tags": [
          "research-memory"
        ],
        "operationId": "import_annotations",
        "parameters": [
          {
            "name": "Idempotency-Key",
            "in": "header",
            "required": true,
            "schema": {
              "type": "string",
              "format": "uuid"
            }
          }
        ],
        "requestBody": {
          "content": {
            "application/json": {
              "schema": {
                "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ResearchAnnotationImportBody"
              }
            }
          },
          "required": true
        },
        "responses": {
          "200": {
            "description": "Atomic principal-scoped annotation archive import",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ResearchAnnotationImportEnvelope"
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "400": {
            "description": "Invalid or unbounded research export",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelopeSchema"
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "409": {
            "description": "Archive collision, unavailable retained source, or idempotency conflict",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelopeSchema"
                }
              }
            }
          }
        },
        "security": [
          {
            "oidcBearer": []
          }
        ]
      }
    },
    "/v1/annotations/{annotation_id}": {
      "put": {
        "tags": [
          "research-memory"
        ],
        "operationId": "put_annotation",
        "parameters": [
          {
            "name": "annotation_id",
            "in": "path",
            "required": true,
            "schema": {
              "type": "string",
              "format": "uuid"
            }
          },
          {
            "name": "Idempotency-Key",
            "in": "header",
            "required": true,
            "schema": {
              "type": "string",
              "format": "uuid"
            }
          }
        ],
        "requestBody": {
          "content": {
            "application/json": {
              "schema": {
                "$ref": "#/components/schemas/AnnotationWriteBody"
              }
            }
          },
          "required": true
        },
        "responses": {
          "200": {
            "description": "Canonical annotation",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/AnnotationMutationEnvelope"
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "404": {
            "description": "Paper, generation, block, or annotation not found",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelopeSchema"
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "409": {
            "description": "Body conflict retains both versions",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/AnnotationConflictEnvelope"
                }
              }
            }
          }
        },
        "security": [
          {
            "oidcBearer": []
          }
        ]
      },
      "delete": {
        "tags": [
          "research-memory"
        ],
        "operationId": "delete_annotation",
        "parameters": [
          {
            "name": "annotation_id",
            "in": "path",
            "required": true,
            "schema": {
              "type": "string",
              "format": "uuid"
            }
          },
          {
            "name": "operation_id",
            "in": "path",
            "required": true,
            "schema": {
              "type": "string",
              "format": "uuid"
            }
          },
          {
            "name": "base_revision",
            "in": "path",
            "required": true,
            "schema": {
              "type": "integer",
              "format": "int64"
            }
          },
          {
            "name": "Idempotency-Key",
            "in": "header",
            "required": true,
            "schema": {
              "type": "string",
              "format": "uuid"
            }
          }
        ],
        "responses": {
          "200": {
            "description": "",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/AnnotationMutationEnvelope"
                }
              }
            }
          }
        },
        "security": [
          {
            "oidcBearer": []
          }
        ]
      }
    },
    "/v1/annotations/{annotation_id}/reanchor": {
      "post": {
        "tags": [
          "research-memory"
        ],
        "operationId": "reanchor_annotation",
        "parameters": [
          {
            "name": "annotation_id",
            "in": "path",
            "required": true,
            "schema": {
              "type": "string",
              "format": "uuid"
            }
          },
          {
            "name": "Idempotency-Key",
            "in": "header",
            "required": true,
            "schema": {
              "type": "string",
              "format": "uuid"
            }
          }
        ],
        "requestBody": {
          "content": {
            "application/json": {
              "schema": {
                "$ref": "#/components/schemas/AnnotationReanchorBody"
              }
            }
          },
          "required": true
        },
        "responses": {
          "200": {
            "description": "",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/AnnotationMutationEnvelope"
                }
              }
            }
          }
        },
        "security": [
          {
            "oidcBearer": []
          }
        ]
      }
    },
    "/v1/assistant/provenance/{provenance_id}": {
      "get": {
        "tags": [
          "papers"
        ],
        "operationId": "assistant_provenance",
        "parameters": [
          {
            "name": "provenance_id",
            "in": "path",
            "required": true,
            "schema": {
              "type": "string",
              "format": "uuid"
            }
          }
        ],
        "responses": {
          "200": {
            "description": "Bounded provenance visible only to its creating principal",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/AssistantProvenanceEnvelope"
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "400": {
            "description": "Anonymous session is required for guest provenance",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelopeSchema"
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "403": {
            "description": "Full-text policy denied",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelopeSchema"
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "404": {
            "description": "Provenance not found in this principal scope",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelopeSchema"
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "503": {
            "description": "Assistant or dependency unavailable",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelopeSchema"
                }
              }
            }
          }
        },
        "security": [
          {},
          {
            "oidcBearer": []
          }
        ]
      }
    },
    "/v1/comments/{comment_id}": {
      "delete": {
        "tags": [
          "comments"
        ],
        "description": "Repeat-safe author deletion. Request bodies are rejected; COMMENT_CREATION_ENABLED does not disable deletion.",
        "operationId": "delete_comment",
        "parameters": [
          {
            "name": "comment_id",
            "in": "path",
            "description": "Comment ID",
            "required": true,
            "schema": {
              "type": "string",
              "format": "uuid"
            }
          }
        ],
        "responses": {
          "204": {
            "description": "Comment is deleted",
            "headers": {
              "Cache-Control": {
                "schema": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "Always private, no-store"
              }
            }
          },
          "400": {
            "description": "INVALID_REQUEST",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelopeSchema"
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "401": {
            "description": "UNAUTHENTICATED or TOKEN_EXPIRED",
            "headers": {
              "WWW-Authenticate": {
                "schema": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "Bearer challenge"
              }
            },
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelopeSchema"
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "403": {
            "description": "ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED or ACCOUNT_DELETION_PENDING",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelopeSchema"
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "404": {
            "description": "COMMENT_NOT_FOUND",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelopeSchema"
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "429": {
            "description": "RATE_LIMITED",
            "headers": {
              "Retry-After": {
                "schema": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "Seconds until the shared mutation window resets"
              }
            },
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelopeSchema"
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "503": {
            "description": "AUTHENTICATION_UNAVAILABLE or COMMENT_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelopeSchema"
                }
              }
            }
          }
        },
        "security": [
          {
            "oidcBearer": []
          }
        ]
      },
      "patch": {
        "tags": [
          "comments"
        ],
        "description": "Replaces the authenticated author's comment body using optimistic version concurrency. The comment-creation kill switch does not disable author edits.",
        "operationId": "edit_comment",
        "parameters": [
          {
            "name": "comment_id",
            "in": "path",
            "description": "Comment ID",
            "required": true,
            "schema": {
              "type": "string",
              "format": "uuid"
            }
          }
        ],
        "requestBody": {
          "content": {
            "application/json": {
              "schema": {
                "$ref": "#/components/schemas/EditCommentBody"
              },
              "example": {
                "body": "Updated observation.",
                "expected_version": 2
              }
            }
          },
          "required": true
        },
        "responses": {
          "200": {
            "description": "Canonical edited comment",
            "headers": {
              "Cache-Control": {
                "schema": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "Always private, no-store"
              }
            },
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/CommentEnvelope"
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "400": {
            "description": "INVALID_REQUEST, INVALID_COMMENT_BODY, or INVALID_COMMENT_VERSION",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelopeSchema"
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "401": {
            "description": "UNAUTHENTICATED or TOKEN_EXPIRED",
            "headers": {
              "WWW-Authenticate": {
                "schema": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "Bearer challenge"
              }
            },
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelopeSchema"
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "403": {
            "description": "ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED or ACCOUNT_DELETION_PENDING",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelopeSchema"
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "404": {
            "description": "COMMENT_NOT_FOUND",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelopeSchema"
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "409": {
            "description": "COMMENT_EDIT_CONFLICT",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelopeSchema"
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "422": {
            "description": "COMMENT_REJECTED",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelopeSchema"
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "429": {
            "description": "RATE_LIMITED",
            "headers": {
              "Retry-After": {
                "schema": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "Seconds until the shared mutation window resets"
              }
            },
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelopeSchema"
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "503": {
            "description": "AUTHENTICATION_UNAVAILABLE or COMMENT_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelopeSchema"
                }
              }
            }
          }
        },
        "security": [
          {
            "oidcBearer": []
          }
        ]
      }
    },
    "/v1/comments/{comment_id}/reports": {
      "post": {
        "tags": [
          "comments"
        ],
        "description": "Creates or returns the authenticated user's canonical report. Report detail never appears in the response or diagnostics.",
        "operationId": "report_comment",
        "parameters": [
          {
            "name": "comment_id",
            "in": "path",
            "description": "Comment ID",
            "required": true,
            "schema": {
              "type": "string",
              "format": "uuid"
            }
          }
        ],
        "requestBody": {
          "content": {
            "application/json": {
              "schema": {
                "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ReportCommentBody"
              },
              "example": {
                "detail": "Optional bounded context",
                "reason": "harassment"
              }
            }
          },
          "required": true
        },
        "responses": {
          "200": {
            "description": "Canonical idempotent report receipt",
            "headers": {
              "Cache-Control": {
                "schema": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "Always private, no-store"
              }
            },
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/CommentReportEnvelope"
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "400": {
            "description": "INVALID_REQUEST or INVALID_REPORT_DETAIL",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelopeSchema"
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "401": {
            "description": "UNAUTHENTICATED or TOKEN_EXPIRED",
            "headers": {
              "WWW-Authenticate": {
                "schema": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "Bearer challenge"
              }
            },
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelopeSchema"
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "403": {
            "description": "ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED or ACCOUNT_DELETION_PENDING",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelopeSchema"
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "404": {
            "description": "COMMENT_NOT_FOUND",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelopeSchema"
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "429": {
            "description": "RATE_LIMITED",
